metadata.title: Algorand & ASA Tracker
metadata.description: Algorand & ASA Tracker: historical holders, activity, LP, supply, nodes, RWA (Exodus, WTR, ebitts, Meld), USDC, and live wallet portfolios.

resources.description: Cross-ASA activity highlights. Query period=daily|weekly|monthly (prices $0.05/$0.15/$0.40).

period.description: period=daily|weekly|monthly. Prices: daily=$0.05, weekly=$0.15, monthly=$0.40. Missing defaults to daily.

resources.description: Algorand Foundation–related holder wallets snapshot for ALGO (full list in one response; not paged).
Historical total Foundation holdings series. Optional maxDays (30|90|180); omit = full history.

maxDays.description: Optional maxDays: 30 | 90 | 180. Omit for full available history. Prices: 30=$0.02, 90=$0.04, 180=$0.06, omit=$0.10. Other values rejected.

resources.description: Current Algorand online participation nodes snapshot (paged). Rows include amount, daily / weekly / monthly / 90-day / 180-day changes, incentive eligibility, key end, sig type, and upgradeVote (yes|no) when a consensus upgrade vote is recorded. sortBy includes UpgradeVote. Response also has upgradeVoteActive. One payment = one page (page, pageSize).

page.description: Page index (0-based). One payment = one page.

resources.description: History for a specific nodes stake bucket. Required: bucketKey. Optional maxDays (30|90|180); omit = full history.

maxDays.description: Optional maxDays: 30 | 90 | 180. Omit for full available history. Prices: 30=$0.02, 90=$0.04, 180=$0.06, omit=$0.10. Other values rejected.

resources.description: Historical series for ALGO nodes aggregates. Optional maxDays (30|90|180); omit = full available history.

maxDays.description: Optional maxDays: 30 | 90 | 180. Omit for full available history. Prices: 30=$0.02, 90=$0.04, 180=$0.06, omit=$0.10. Other values rejected.

resources.description: Nodes newly appearing on the tracked nodes list within lookback. Query days (7|30|60|90|180).

days.description: Lookback: 7 | 30 | 60 | 90 | 180. Not a calendar date. Invalid/missing priced as 30. Prices: 7=$0.02, 30=$0.04, 60=$0.05, 90=$0.06, 180=$0.08

resources.description: Chart pack: ALGO online-nodes new entrants for all lookback windows in one response (data keys 7|30|60|90|180). Fixed price $0.20 (~20% less than five separate days-ladder calls). No query parameters.
Nodes that left the tracked nodes list within lookback. Query days (7|30|60|90|180).

days.description: Lookback: 7 | 30 | 60 | 90 | 180. Not a calendar date. Invalid/missing priced as 30. Prices: 7=$0.02, 30=$0.04, 60=$0.05, 90=$0.06, 180=$0.08

resources.description: Chart pack: ALGO online-nodes previously-in-list for all lookback windows in one response (data keys 7|30|60|90|180). Fixed price $0.20 (~20% less than five separate days-ladder calls). No query parameters.

Community vs Foundation share of online-node ALGO (WalletNames.Type=AlgorandFoundation among current/daily online nodes). Latest percents plus daily history. Not Foundation tab balances (use foundation-total-history for that). Optional maxDays (30|90|180); omit = full history ($0.10, proxied as maxDays=366 because Tracker /api omit defaults to 90).

maxDays.description: Optional maxDays: 30 | 90 | 180. Omit = full available history ($0.10). For ALGO nodes/foundation history and Exodus daily-history, omit is proxied as maxDays=366 (Tracker /api omit defaults to a shorter window). Prices: 30=$0.02, 90=$0.04, 180=$0.06, omit=$0.10. Other values rejected.

resources.description: Per-node-wallet stake history. Required: walletAddress. Optional maxDays (30|90|180); omit = full history.

maxDays.description: Optional maxDays: 30 | 90 | 180. Omit for full available history. Prices: 30=$0.02, 90=$0.04, 180=$0.06, omit=$0.10. Other values rejected.

resources.description: App unique-senders time series. Required: appName. Optional maxDays (30|90|180); omit = full history.

maxDays.description: Optional maxDays: 30 | 90 | 180. Omit for full available history. Prices: 30=$0.02, 90=$0.04, 180=$0.06, omit=$0.10. Other values rejected.

resources.description: ASA or ALGO (asaId=0) activity metrics. Daily returns the latest completed comparison. Query period=daily|weekly|monthly (prices $0.02/$0.06/$0.16; omit = daily). recordDate is supported only for weekly/monthly. Invalid input â 400 before payment.

period.description: period=daily|weekly|monthly. Prices: daily=$0.02, weekly=$0.06, monthly=$0.16. Missing defaults to daily.

resources.description: Activity-tab supply-distribution and price-change scores for one ASA (or ALGO asaId=0). Not the same as /supply-distribution (snapshot). Returns period metrics that moved meaningfully vs prior window (importance score 1–10), plus optional price metric. Query period=daily|weekly|monthly (prices $0.02/$0.06/$0.16; omit = daily). Optional recordDate. Empty metrics means no qualifying moves for that period.

period.description: period=daily|weekly|monthly. Prices: daily=$0.02, weekly=$0.06, monthly=$0.16. Missing defaults to daily.

resources.description: Latest LP holders snapshot (up to 300 wallets per ASA; full list in one response, not paged). Includes amount/share and daily / weekly / monthly / 90-day / 180-day changes.
Chart pack: LP previously-in-list for all lookback windows in one response (data keys 7|30|60|90|180). Fixed price $0.20 (~20% less than five separate days-ladder calls). No query parameters.
Current supply-distribution snapshot for the ASA (or ALGO asaId=0): category and institution breakdown.

Latest top-holders snapshot (paged). Dataset caps match the website: ALGO (asaId=0) up to 2000 wallets above ~100k ALGO; default ASA up to 500; ASA.STATS (393537671) up to 200; TINY (2200000000) up to 700. Each row includes amount/total, share, and daily / weekly / monthly / 90-day / 180-day balance changes. One payment = one page (page, pageSize).

page.description: Page index (0-based). One payment = one page.

sortBy.description: Amount | TotalAmount | DailyChange | WeeklyChange | MonthlyChange | Change90 | Change180

walletPrefix.description: Optional wallet address or name prefix filter

resources.description: Wallets on the latest day's top-holders list whose first recorded day falls within the lookback. DEX/pool-type wallets excluded. Query days (7|30|60|90|180). Omit days priced as 30. Other values â 400 before payment.

days.description: Lookback: 7 | 30 | 60 | 90 | 180. Not a calendar date. Invalid/missing priced as 30. Prices: 7=$0.02, 30=$0.04, 60=$0.05, 90=$0.06, 180=$0.08

resources.description: Chart pack: top-holders new entrants for all lookback windows in one response (data keys 7|30|60|90|180). Fixed price $0.20 (~20% less than five separate days-ladder calls). No query parameters.

Wallets not on the latest day's top-holders list but present at least one day in the lookback. Response shows peak total in that window. DEX/pool-type wallets excluded. Query days (7|30|60|90|180). Omit days priced as 30. Other values â 400 before payment.

days.description: Lookback: 7 | 30 | 60 | 90 | 180. Not a calendar date. Invalid/missing priced as 30. Prices: 7=$0.02, 30=$0.04, 60=$0.05, 90=$0.06, 180=$0.08
